title: Cotton favor bags
text: Cotton favor bags. I bought these to hold the plastic gold coins we use when playing Tripoly.  They are heavy duty cotton and the perfect size, not too small, not too large. I used 4, each holding 100 plastic coins... however, there is room for 400 or so coins if you'd like.  The other 2 I used to put my grandsons matchboxes and other small toys in.  The cotton draw strings are also sturdy.  I didn't wash them.. but because they appear to be cotton you could.  The measurements given on the sale page seem to be accurate, eye balling it.  I always update my reviews should new info be useful.
